title.narrative: Improved Peaceful Coexistence and Social Cohesion for communities in Ninewa and Salah Din governorates, Iraq.

description.narrative: Overall objective: By 2026, social cohesion and peaceful coexistence, including the reintegration of refugees and returnees, will be strengthened in Ninewa Governorate.Project objective: 750 project participants and their household members in the districts of Hamdaniya, Talafar and Sinjar in the governorate of Ninewa use non-violent and inclusive communication and improved economic relations to promote social cohesion and peaceful coexistence.Target 1: 750 members of vulnerable groups of returnees, host communities and government authorities have improved capacities for interaction and networking, and increased opportunities for social interaction and social cohesion.Target 2: 360 vulnerable members of returnee and host communities have access to improved livelihoods.Target 3: WEO's capacity for sustainable and high-quality service delivery with a focus on agricultural livelihoods and administrative efficiency is strengthened.

The overall objective is to strengthen the social cohesion and peaceful co-existence in Sinjar and Tikrit districts through ensuring community based resolution mechanisms are in use and working effectively; access to livelihood opportunities for community interdependence is improved; women and youth are empowered to participate in peace building forums; networking, coordination and learning between local level and state level peace building institutions improved, strengthened partner capacities.

The primary target groups for the project are made up of community members from the districts of Hamdaniya, Talafar and Sinjar. These groups are made up of various sub-groups such as local authorities, community leaders, religious leaders, youth and women. Indirect participants comprise the wider community who will benefit from the knowledge and skills imparted to the primary participants. Local authorities, including community councils, will act as multipliers by integrating the training and knowledge received into their administrative practices, thus reaching wider community segments. Community leaders, religious figures and youth activists will share their newly acquired knowledge and strategies within their networks, creating a multiplier effect that expands the impact of the project. At the authority level, the involvement will include local government representatives, local councillors and community police who will facilitate the implementation and sustainability of the project initiatives. Similarly, the focus here will be on local key individuals, youth groups and women's organizations to ensure that knowledge is passed on to family members, neighbors and peers, thus strengthening the overall social fabric in Hamdaniya, Talafar and Sinjar.The target group includes several age groups, ensuring that activities are tailored to the needs of different demographic groups, with a particular focus on the inclusion of youth and women. The overall structure of the target group reflects a balanced approach with a 50% representation of women, with a focus on ensuring that young people and other age groups are represented in all activities.
